# Æon Core

> Æon is a free, open-source Python runtime (Apache-2.0) that gates the actions of LLM agents and injects controlled faults to check that they fail safe. Alpha, v0.5.0 in development, not yet on PyPI. The gate decides synchronously before a tool runs (go, alert, limit, block); observation (hash-chained audit log, behavioural baseline) runs asynchronously. Adoption is shadow-first. Inspired by the MECADE framework for chaos engineering; an independent project. It is not certified for anything, and the gate only covers actions that pass through the wrapped executor.

Docs are available in English and Brazilian Portuguese (add `pt/` after the docs root for Portuguese).

## Get started

- [Install](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/get-started/install/): pip, uv, uvx, pipx; install from a checkout until the first release
- [Quickstart (5 minutes)](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/get-started/quickstart/): init, gate an agent, shadow then enforce, verify the audit log, inject a fault
- [Prompt for a coding agent](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/get-started/coding-agent/): a copy-paste prompt that uses only documented commands
- [Where it runs](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/get-started/where-it-runs/): local, Docker, CI, any Python agent

## Concepts

- [Gate and observation path](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/concepts/gate/): the decision path and the observation path
- [Autonomy levels](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/concepts/autonomy-levels/): GO, ALERT, LIMIT, BLOCK in shadow and enforce modes
- [Safe State](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/concepts/safe-state/): what happens after BLOCK, and the kill-switch
- [Budget and deviation](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/concepts/budget/): the baseline, z-scores, CUSUM and envelope math
- [Fault catalog](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/concepts/faults/): eight faults and their blast radius
- [Audit chain](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/concepts/audit-chain/): record format, verification, what it does not detect
- [Shadow-first adoption](https://www.richardsonlima.com.br/aeon/docs/concepts/shadow-first/): shadow, ALERT, LIMIT, BLOCK
